industry: Investment Banking / Capital Markets / Financial Services IT
role_summary: Senior VDI and Desktop Engineering role responsible for designing, deploying, and troubleshooting Citrix/NetScaler infrastructure (physical and virtual), Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, and integration with VMware, Nutanix, AWS, and Azure Virtual Desktop. Also covers desktop engineering including Windows 10/11 endpoint management (Intune/SCCM), thin client deployment (IGEL), Active Directory administration, automation/scripting, and L1-L3 incident support in a fast-paced financial services environment.
must_have_requirements: 7-10 years of experience in VDI and Desktop Engineering
Extensive hands-on knowledge of Citrix NetScaler (physical and virtual environments)
In-depth knowledge of Citrix ADM and its integration with NetScaler
Expertise in GSLB, load balancing, SSL certificates, and standard NetScaler features
Experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (on-prem and Citrix Cloud)
Experience integrating Citrix infrastructure (FAS, Cloud Connectors, StoreFront)
Expert knowledge in VMware and Nutanix virtualization platforms
Experience integrating Citrix with AWS and Azure, including Azure Virtual Desktop
Strong knowledge of Active Directory (policies, OU, DNS)
Strong Windows 10/11 deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting experience
Experience managing endpoints via Microsoft Endpoint Manager (Intune) or SCCM
Experience troubleshooting via GUI and CLI for L1/L2/L3 issues
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience with Windows 365 (Cloud PC) integration with Citrix Cloud
Automation/scripting experience with ServiceNow, UiPath, Power Automate, PowerShell
Experience building and deploying IGEL thin clients
Knowledge of firewall and EPA advanced NetScaler features
Packaging and scripting for automated software deployment
Experience supporting Microsoft 365 apps (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
Understanding of endpoint security best practices (antivirus, encryption, patch management)
Networking basics: LAN/WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing
soft_skills_priority: Customer service orientation for end-user support
Communication and interpersonal skills across technical and business audiences
Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment
Team collaboration and willingness to assist on any project
Adaptability across audiences, environments, and cultures

scoring_criteria.name: Citrix NetScaler Expertise
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core requirement for the role; NetScaler is the primary ADC/load balancing platform requiring deep hands-on expertise.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from pure desktop support backgrounds may lack NetScaler-specific ADC experience.

scoring_criteria.name: Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops / Citrix Cloud
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Central VDI platform for delivering virtual apps/desktops; on-prem and cloud proficiency is essential.

scoring_criteria.name: Virtualization Platforms (VMware & Nutanix)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Underlying infrastructure for Citrix environments; expert-level knowledge is explicitly required.

scoring_criteria.name: Cloud Integration (AWS/Azure/AVD)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Modern Citrix deployments increasingly leverage cloud platforms, especially Azure Virtual Desktop.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May have stronger on-prem experience than cloud-native AVD/Windows 365 exposure.

scoring_criteria.name: Desktop Engineering & Endpoint Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Significant portion of role involves Windows 10/11 deployment and endpoint management via Intune/SCCM.

scoring_criteria.name: Active Directory & Networking Fundamentals
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Foundational for both Citrix infrastructure and desktop environments.

scoring_criteria.name: Automation & Scripting
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Automation tools reduce manual workload and are called out as a distinct skill area.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Many VDI engineers have PowerShell but limited RPA tool exposure (UiPath/Power Automate).

scoring_criteria.name: Thin Client Management (IGEL)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Specific endpoint technology mentioned for VDI delivery.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Common gap if prior experience is with Dell Wyse or other thin client vendors.

scoring_criteria.name: Incident Management & Customer Support
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role spans L1-L3 support with direct end-user interaction in a demanding financial services environment.

scoring_criteria.name: Soft Skills & Communication
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires cross-functional collaboration and clear communication in a fast-paced, high-stakes financial environment.

summary_focus: Lead with years of VDI/Desktop Engineering experience (7-10+) and Citrix/NetScaler specialization
Highlight NetScaler ADC, GSLB, load balancing, and SSL certificate expertise
Emphasize Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops experience across on-prem and Citrix Cloud
Showcase virtualization depth in VMware and Nutanix
Mention cloud integration experience (Azure Virtual Desktop, AWS) if applicable
Include endpoint management tools (Intune/SCCM) and Windows 10/11 deployment experience
Reference automation/scripting tools used (PowerShell, Power Automate, UiPath) if genuinely applied
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim 'expert' level in Nutanix or Windows 365 if only exposed briefly or through documentation
Do not overstate IGEL experience if only familiar with general thin client concepts
Do not imply Citrix Access Gateway experience if only worked with NetScaler Gateway without Access Gateway specifics
Do not inflate automation tool usage (UiPath/Power Automate) if experience is limited to basic scripting

cover_letter_guidance.tone: Professional, technically confident, and customer-service oriented—reflecting the precision expected in financial services IT environments.
cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position candidate as a seasoned Citrix/NetScaler and VDI specialist who bridges infrastructure engineering with hands-on desktop support, capable of supporting a global investment bank's demanding, fast-paced environment.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If Azure Virtual Desktop or Windows 365 exposure is limited, emphasize strong Azure fundamentals and rapid learning ability with cloud VDI platforms
If automation tool experience (UiPath/Power Automate) is minimal, highlight strong PowerShell scripting and willingness to expand into RPA tools
If IGEL-specific experience is absent, reference transferable thin client management experience (e.g., Dell Wyse, other endpoint platforms)
If Nutanix exposure is secondary to VMware, be transparent about primary platform depth while noting hyperconverged infrastructure familiarity
